description: This file defines the VercelAiGatewayEmbedder class, which implements the IEmbedder interface to provide embedding functionalities via Vercel AI Gateway, wrapping an OpenAICompatibleEmbedder. It includes methods for creating embeddings, validating configuration, and retrieving embedder info. It also specifies supported models and handles errors with telemetry.

classes.name: VercelAiGatewayEmbedder
classes.description: Implementation of an embedder that interfaces with Vercel AI Gateway's embedding API, wrapping an OpenAI-compatible embedder and providing methods for creating embeddings, validation, and info retrieval.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the embedder with API key and optional model ID, creating an internal OpenAICompatibleEmbedder instance.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Creates text embeddings using the Vercel AI Gateway API, with error handling and telemetry logging.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the embedder configuration by delegating to the underlying OpenAI-compatible embedder, with error handling and telemetry.

methods.name: embedderInfo
methods.description: Returns information about this embedder, specifically its name.
